risk_if_not_implemented: Without Attribute Configuration By Authorized Individuals, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Media Marking
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to mark media in accordance with data protection requirements so that personnel are alerted to distribution limitations, handling caveats and applicable security requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Media Marking (DCH-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Attribute Configuration By Authorized Individuals (DCH-37.10) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cybersecurity & Data Protection Attributes
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to bind cybersecurity and data protection attributes to information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cybersecurity & Data Protection Attributes (DCH-37) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Attribute Configuration By Authorized Individuals (DCH-37.10) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
